mkgmap_path.description: Absolute path to the mkgmap binary.

input_dir.description: Directory where source OpenStreetMap data files are stored.

output_dir.description: Directory where generated Garmin .img files will be saved.

map_style.description: Path to the mkgmap style directory. Leave empty if using defaults or specifying via args.

mkgmap_args.description: List of additional command-line arguments to pass to mkgmap.

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose output from mkgmap.
